answer.subgoal: Explain the three categories of interaction in immersive systems: object interaction, navigation, and system control.
Explain the distinction between object selection and manipulation and the parameters influencing selection performance.
Describe various hand-based selection techniques, including go-go, prism, and intent-driven selection.
Describe pointing-based selection techniques and their improvements like bend cast and depth ray.
Describe image plane selection techniques such as head crusher, sticky finger, and framing hands.
Describe volumetric selection techniques like cone casting, sphere casting, and bimanual selection.
Explain the different categories of manipulation techniques and specifically how hand manipulation works.
Describe indirect manipulation techniques using 3D widgets, proxies, and world in miniature.
Explain bimanual manipulation techniques, specifically the spindle and spindle plus wheel methods.
Describe integrated hybrid manipulation techniques like the HOMER method.
Summarize the main points of the lecture.
